records.name: MENA Undergraduate Pre-Law Society
records.summary: A student society at Penn for undergraduates interested in law and the Middle East and North Africa. It offers pre-law mentorship, networking, and discussion of regional affairs.
records.what_you_do: Members get pre-law mentorship, networking with professionals, and talks about the region's politics and culture.

first_step.how: Email the club to express interest. It is accepting all members and some board seats for Fall 2026.

records.name: Medical Volunteers for Prevention
records.summary: A Penn pre-medical student group that builds lessons on preventing health problems and teaches them to communities across Philadelphia. Its current projects cover sexual health, health insurance basics, and nutrition.
records.what_you_do: Members write and deliver prevention lessons alongside health experts, and they serve on finance, human resources, or recruiting and marketing committees.

first_step.how: Apply through the club's current application form for fall 2026 (applications are reviewed on a rolling basis), or email the club with questions.
first_step.basis: An application is required before a student joins, and the club reviews applications on a rolling basis.

records.notes: Active rests on the directory text, which says the application for FA26 (fall 2026) is open. The club website shows no dated item; its only date is inside an image file name, which was ignored. The directory INACTIVE flag conflicts with its active field. The website's APPLY page and the application form were not opened. The month is not given, so last_sign_of_life is left out.

records.name: Nonprofit Connect
records.summary: A Penn program, run with the Netter Center and the Wharton Undergraduate Division, that pairs student teams with Philadelphia nonprofits for year-long projects.
records.what_you_do: Students join a project team that works with one local nonprofit for a year, bringing their skills to the nonprofit's work.

first_step.how: Apply with the written member application for the next cohort. Applications are taken for a set cohort, and questions go to the club email.
first_step.basis: Students apply with a written form for a set cohort, so the way in is not open at all times.

records.notes: Active rests on the directory text: member applications for the F26/S27 cohort were open, with a stated deadline of September 14 that has now passed. The directory INACTIVE flag conflicts with its active and approved fields. Next cohort timing is not known.

records.name: Nutrition Education Service Team (NEST) at Penn
records.summary: A student service club that promotes good nutrition at Penn and across Philadelphia through education and volunteer work.
records.what_you_do: Members attend general meetings and join volunteer events. New people sign up on the club's listserv form to hear about the first meeting of fall 2026.

first_step.how: Add your email to the club's listserv form. The club says it will contact people at the start of the fall 2026 semester about its first meeting and volunteer events.
first_step.basis: The directory says no application is needed, and anyone can join the email list.

records.notes: Probably active: the only dated item is the club's own directory text, which plans for the start of fall 2026. No event with a date is listed. The Instagram page was not read (lead only). No website is linked.

records.name: Onyx Senior Honor Society
records.summary: A Penn senior honor society, founded in 1974, that recognizes students for scholarship, leadership, and service. Members run community service, academic support workshops, and alumni programs.
records.what_you_do: Members take part in community service, academic workshops, and alumni programs. The graduate board has set five initiatives for 2026, including mentorship of undergraduate members and an alumni job bank.

records.name: Penn Sailing Team
records.summary: Penn's competitive collegiate sailing team. It races against other colleges at weekend regattas in the fall and spring and trains on the water several afternoons each week.
records.what_you_do: Members train in the gym and on the water at least three days a week, and they travel for weekend races during the fall and spring seasons.

schedule.text: Practice on Tuesday, Thursday, and Friday, about 3:30 to 7:15 pm, plus weekend regattas in the fall and spring seasons.

MENA Undergraduate Pre-Law Society, Medical Volunteers for Prevention and Nonprofit Connect are active on fall 2026 recruiting text in the club's own directory entry, because their linked sites (or no site) showed no readable dated item. NEST and Onyx are probably_active on weaker evidence (a planned fall 2026 start, and a 2026 initiatives heading with no dates). Please review those five before publishing. Fourteen are held back with status unknown, because neither the directory entry nor a readable site shows a dated item in the last 12 months. Neurotech@Penn's posts sit behind a LinkedIn sign-in prompt, so nothing was used from them. PAGSA's welcome reception is dated Oct. 1 with no year, so it could not be placed in time.
